'''Bergmark''' is a highland region associated with [[Imperial Rhovland]] and the [[Rontzken]] language.

The extracted Rontzken source describes Bergmark as one of the language's principal speech regions and ties it to mountain communities, mining settlements, stonework, and highland cultural memory.

== Draft Scope ==

This is a cultural-geography bridge page. It does not yet establish Bergmark's constitutional status, exact borders, major cities, noble families, or 1994 population.
